ws.rationale: Transitive through @stacks/connect 8.2.6 and Reown/WalletConnect. npm's fix is a breaking downgrade to 8.1.9; Leather, Xverse, reconnect, cancellation, transaction signing, message signing, and mobile handoff must pass before changing this boundary.
ws.compensatingControl: Wallet connectivity is client-side; API request and connection limits do not expose a websocket server. Keep dependencies audited weekly and retest when Stacks Connect publishes a compatible fixed path.
